checks.cmd: set +e; cd /app; out=$(python3 -c 'from libcloud.reclaim2 import Money, ReclaimTarget, ReclaimPlanner, Action, Outcome; print("IMPORT_OK", Action.STOP_NODE, Outcome.PLANNED)' 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 0 ] && echo "$out" | grep -q IMPORT_OK; then echo 'IMPORT_OK'; else echo 'IMPORT_FAILED'; echo "$out"; fi; exit 0
checks.expect: IMPORT_OK — a fresh subprocess can import Money, ReclaimTarget, ReclaimPlanner, Action, Outcome from libcloud.reclaim2 and Action.STOP_NODE / Outcome.PLANNED resolve. IMPORT_FAILED = the module the agent claimed ready is not actually importable.

checks.cmd: set +e; cd /app; out=$(python3 -c 'from libcloud.reclaim2 import RetentionConfig; r = RetentionConfig(keep_last=3); print("RC_OK", r.keep_last)' 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 0 ] && echo "$out" | grep -q 'RC_OK 3'; then echo 'RETENTIONCONFIG_OK'; else echo 'RETENTIONCONFIG_BROKEN'; echo "$out"; fi; exit 0
checks.expect: RETENTIONCONFIG_OK — RetentionConfig imports from the reclaim2 top level and accepts keep_last=3. RETENTIONCONFIG_BROKEN = the export is gone, renamed, or does not accept the fixed keyword.
